combo_label: Things That Beep × Herbs & Spices × Ghosts & Hauntings

entries.clue: One who claims a sixth sense for what the rest of us miss.
Kitchen box that reheats leftovers, then beeps until you come back and apologise.
The smallest quantity a recipe calls for, lifted dry in the fingertips
Creeping apple-scented lawn plant whose daisies make a bedtime brew
Lighthouse's deep bellow, sounded when the whole coast has disappeared in mist
Wristband that judders in celebration at ten thousand steps, then nags you to stand
Pensioner's four-wheeled pavement buggy, beeping as it reverses out of the chemist's
Ball of light in a night photograph, seized on by camera-toting hunters
Filmy white emanation of the darkened seance room, often exposed as cheesecloth.
Kalonji, the small jet-black seed speckling the crust of a fresh naan
